CustomField.description: Days after the end of a partner's temporary access before the nightly check marks it Access Denied and deactivates the portal users of the partner and its executives. With 0 this happens the first night after the end date, so from then on no login page lets them in. More days keep their users active a little longer (for visits and conversions entered late); the portal's login page refuses them, and the portal shows them only that their access has ended, from the day after the end date in any case.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days after the temporary access ends before the nightly check marks the partner Access Denied and deactivates its users and its executives' users. 0 = the first night after the end date.
CustomField.label: Denial Grace Days
